title: Matt LaFleur on Keisean Nixon's complaints about second-team reps: "Everybody's in competition"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matt LaFleur on Keisean Nixon's complaints about second-team reps: "Everybody's in competition"
sources.description: Packers cornerback Keisean Nixon recently said he feels like he's being "punished" by being required to compete for a starting job, which includes Nixon taking second-team reps.
